description: Call Member Avatar when request is out-of-scope for underlying intelligence, or specifically asked by member
name: callAvatar

fidelity.description: A confidence score from 0-10 of how much the bot thinks the request is out of scope, where 0 is least confident and 10 is most confident. This also respresents how strongly the bot recommends the Avatar handle the request.

reason.description: An explanation of why the bot believes this is out of scope with respect to its current responsibilities.

recommendedIntelligence.description: A recommendation of what the bot believes may be a better suited intelligence for the member's request.

request.description: The original out-of-scope request from the member
